mapper.sql: nm.id AS notification_id, nm.recipient_user_id, nm.channel_code, nm.title, nm.body, nm.status_code, nm.resource_type, nm.resource_id, nm.read_at, nm.sent_at, nm.created_at
ot.id AS task_id, ot.task_type_code, ot.status_code, ot.priority_code, ot.title, ot.description, ot.resource_type, ot.resource_id, ot.due_at, ot.completed_at, ot.created_at, ot.updated_at
mapper.select: -- Count active user by id. SELECT count(1) FROM users u WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.status_code = 'ACTIVE'

-- Select active notification template by code and channel. SELECT nt.id AS template_id, nt.template_code, nt.channel_code, nt.title_template, nt.body_template, nt.is_active AS active FROM notification_templates nt WHERE nt.template_code = #{templateCode} AND nt.channel_code = #{channelCode}
-- Count notification messages for recipient. SELECT count(1) FROM notification_messages nm

-- Select one notification message. SELECT
FROM notification_messages nm WHERE nm.id = #{notificationId}
mapper.insert: -- Insert notification message. INSERT INTO notification_messages ( id, recipient_user_id, template_id, channel_code, title, body, status_code, resource_type, resource_id, sent_at, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{notificationId}, #{recipientUserId}, #{templateId,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{channelCode}, #{title}, #{body}, #{statusCode}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId,jdbcType=OTHER}, CASE WHEN #{statusCode} = 'SENT' THEN now() ELSE NULL END, #{actorUserId}, #{actorUserId} )
mapper.update: -- Mark notification message as read. UPDATE notification_messages SET read_at = COALESCE(read_at, now()), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{notificationId}
mapper.insert: -- Insert notification delivery log without provider payload. INSERT INTO notification_delivery_logs ( id, message_id, channel_code, provider_code, delivery_status_code, attempt_no, provider_message_key, failure_code, failure_message, metadata_json ) VALUES ( #{logId}, #{messageId}, #{channelCode}, #{providerCode}, #{deliveryStatusCode}, #{attemptNo}, #{providerMessageKey}, #{failureCode}, #{failureMessage}, CAST(#{metadataJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb) )
mapper.select: -- Count operation tasks. SELECT count(1) FROM operation_tasks ot

-- Select one operation task. SELECT
FROM operation_tasks ot WHERE ot.id = #{taskId}
mapper.insert: -- Insert operation task. INSERT INTO operation_tasks ( id, task_type_code, status_code, priority_code, title, description, resource_type, resource_id, due_at, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{taskId}, #{taskTypeCode}, 'OPEN', #{priorityCode}, #{title}, #{description}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{dueAt}, #{actorUserId}, #{actorUserId} )
mapper.update: -- Update operation task status. UPDATE operation_tasks SET status_code = #{statusCode}, completed_at = CASE WHEN #{statusCode} = 'DONE' THEN now() ELSE completed_at END, updated_by = #{actorUserId}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{taskId}
mapper.select: -- Select one operation task comment. SELECT otc.id AS comment_id, otc.task_id, otc.author_user_id, otc.comment_text, otc.created_at FROM operation_task_comments otc WHERE otc.id = #{commentId}
mapper.insert: -- Insert operation task comment. INSERT INTO operation_task_comments ( id, task_id, author_user_id, comment_text ) VALUES ( #{commentId}, #{taskId}, #{authorUserId}, #{commentText} )
mapper.select: -- Select one operation task assignment. SELECT ota.id AS assignment_id, ota.task_id, ota.assignee_user_id, ota.status_code, ota.assigned_by, ota.assigned_at, ota.completed_at FROM operation_task_assignments ota WHERE ota.id = #{assignmentId}
mapper.insert: -- Insert operation task assignment. INSERT INTO operation_task_assignments ( id, task_id, assignee_user_id, status_code, assigned_by ) VALUES ( #{assignmentId}, #{taskId}, #{assigneeUserId}, 'ASSIGNED', #{assignedBy} )

-- Insert non-PII operation audit log. INSERT INTO audit_logs ( actor_user_id, action_code, resource_type, resource_id, result_code, metadata_json ) VALUES ( #{actorUserId}, #{actionCode}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, #{resultCode}, CAST(#{metadataJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb) )
